title: Anthropic’s Claude AI Uncovers Origins of NSA-Provided Cryptographic Keys After 25 Years
content_md: Anthropic says an internal Claude research model reconstructed how the National Security Agency generated seeds for five NIST elliptic curves in under 30 minutes, addressing a cryptographic mystery spanning roughly 25 years. Its October 16 report attributes the seeds to a standard C pseudorandom number generator initialized with Unix timestamps, rather than secret passphrases.
